impacted.role: `YouTubeFetcher.yt_dlp_cmd` (set in `__init__` to `[sys.executable, '-m', 'yt_dlp']`) prefixes both subprocess calls: channel discovery in `_discover_channel_videos` (stdout JSON lines; a `--break-match-filters upload_date>=YYYYMMDD` argument computed from today) and transcript download in `_extract_transcript` (writes subtitle files into a per-call temporary directory passed with `--output`)

six tests skipped unless PRISMIS_LIVE_NETWORK_TESTS is set; `test_fetch_youtube_with_real_api` guards its item checks with `if items:` and `test_extract_transcript_from_specific_video` guards with `if transcript:`
three tests skipped unless OPENAI_API_KEY is set
the `recorded_llm` marker, recorder and strict replay from recorded-llm-tests
swaps `fetcher.yt_dlp_cmd` for a stand-in script written to tmp_path, the subprocess-boundary pattern

constraints.text: Only external third parties are stood in for; yt-dlp and YouTube are external, the fetcher's parsing is ours and runs for real.
The discovery command carries a date filter computed from the current date, and the transcript command carries a per-call temporary output path, so both vary between runs.
The LLM replay normalizes only dates and the model name and fails loudly on any other mismatch or a missing recording.

related.query: gh issue list --state open --search "youtube OR test" --limit 10
